moments.title: Love Island Final
moments.blurb: The 13th season of Love Island concludes with its grand finale on Monday, where the winning couple will be crowned and take home £50,000.

angles.name: Anticipation
angles.copy: Who's taking home the £50k? The Love Island final is LIVE tomorrow night at 9pm on ITV2 & ITVX! Who are you backing to win?

angles.name: Last chance to vote
angles.copy: It's almost time for the Love Island finale! Get your votes in for your favourite couple before it's too late. Tune in tomorrow at 9pm!

moments.title: Latitude Festival Closes
moments.blurb: Latitude Festival, a major UK music and arts festival in Henham Park, Suffolk, concludes today after four days of music, comedy, and culture.

angles.name: Festival wrap-up
angles.copy: That's a wrap for Latitude 2026! Who had the best set at Henham Park this weekend? Tell us your festival highlights!

angles.name: Sunday vibes
angles.copy: Soaking up the last of the Latitude vibes today in Suffolk. What's been your favourite performance of the weekend?

moments.title: Mick Jagger's 83rd Birthday
moments.blurb: Sir Mick Jagger, the legendary frontman of The Rolling Stones, celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Rock legend
angles.copy: Still got the moves! Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the iconic Sir Mick Jagger. What's your favourite Stones track?

angles.name: Timeless performer
angles.copy: 83 today and still rocking! Mick Jagger, the ultimate frontman, celebrates his birthday. Let's hear your top Rolling Stones anthem!

moments.title: Geddy Lee's 73rd Birthday
moments.blurb: Geddy Lee, the influential bassist, vocalist, and keyboardist of the progressive rock band Rush, turns 73 on Wednesday.

angles.name: Prog rock icon
angles.copy: Happy 73rd birthday to the one and only Geddy Lee from Rush! What's your favourite Rush epic?

angles.name: Rush tribute
angles.copy: Raise a glass to Geddy Lee, celebrating 73 years of incredible music with Rush! Which track showcases his genius best?

moments.title: Kate Bush's 68th Birthday
moments.blurb: The enigmatic and influential British singer-songwriter Kate Bush celebrates her 68th birthday on Thursday.

angles.name: Iconic artist
angles.copy: Happy 68th Birthday to the truly unique and brilliant Kate Bush! Which of her magical songs is your all-time favourite?

angles.name: Running Up That Hill
angles.copy: From 'Wuthering Heights' to 'Running Up That Hill', Kate Bush turns 68 on Thursday! Celebrate her incredible career with your top track!

moments.title: Camp Bestival Dorset Kicks Off
moments.blurb: Camp Bestival, the family-friendly festival at Lulworth Castle, Dorset, begins on Thursday, featuring acts like Bastille, Fatboy Slim, Self Esteem, and Billy Ocean.

angles.name: Festival excitement
angles.copy: Get ready, Dorset! Camp Bestival kicks off this Thursday with an amazing lineup. Who are you most excited to see?

angles.name: Family fun
angles.copy: It's almost time for Camp Bestival! Four days of music, fun and family vibes at Lulworth Castle from Thursday. Who's heading down?

moments.title: Wilderness Festival Starts
moments.blurb: The Wilderness Festival, an acclaimed arts and music event, returns to Cornbury Park, Oxfordshire, from Thursday.

angles.name: Oxfordshire festival
angles.copy: Wilderness Festival is back! Four days of music, arts, food and wellbeing in Oxfordshire starts this Thursday. Are you going wild?

angles.name: Beyond the music
angles.copy: More than just music! Wilderness Festival kicks off Thursday, bringing incredible food, theatre, and wellness to Cornbury Park. What's on your agenda?

moments.title: Y-Not Festival Begins
moments.blurb: Y-Not Festival, Derbyshire's indie and rock music festival, starts on Thursday with headliners including The Libertines, Reytons, Two Door Cinema Club and The Streets.

angles.name: Derbyshire rock
angles.copy: Y-Not Festival is almost here! The Derbyshire fields will be rocking from Thursday with The Libertines, The Streets and more. Who's joining the party?

angles.name: Indie anthems
angles.copy: Ready for some indie anthems? Y-Not Festival kicks off Thursday with a huge lineup! Which band are you most hyped to see?

moments.title: Belladrum Tartan Heart Festival
moments.blurb: Scotland's Belladrum Tartan Heart Festival, near Inverness, begins on Thursday, featuring James, The Human League, and Callum Beattie.

angles.name: Scottish festival
angles.copy: The Tartan Heart is beating! Belladrum Festival kicks off this Thursday near Inverness with James, The Human League & more. Who's heading to the Highlands?

angles.name: Highlands music
angles.copy: Scotland, are you ready? Belladrum Tartan Heart Festival brings three days of incredible music and arts from Thursday! What's your top pick?

moments.title: Premier League Pre-Season Friendlies
moments.blurb: Premier League clubs continue their pre-season preparations with high-profile friendlies, including Aston Villa vs Real Sociedad and Chelsea vs Western Sydney Wanderers tomorrow.

angles.name: Pre-season action
angles.copy: Premier League pre-season heats up! Chelsea take on Western Sydney Wanderers tomorrow, while Aston Villa face Real Sociedad. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Global friendlies
angles.copy: It's another busy week of pre-season friendlies as Premier League clubs travel the globe. Catch the action as teams prepare for the new season!

moments.title: UK Summer Heat Continues
moments.blurb: The UK continues to experience warm and dry conditions, with high pressure dominating and temperatures expected to remain above average for late July.

angles.name: Heatwave update
angles.copy: Another sunny one across much of the UK today! Remember to stay hydrated and slap on that sun cream. How are you enjoying the summer weather?

angles.name: Summer vibes
angles.copy: The summer heat is sticking around! Perfect weather for the beach or a BBQ. What are your plans for soaking up the sun?

moments.title: James Hetfield's 63rd Birthday
moments.blurb: James Hetfield, the iconic frontman, rhythm guitarist, and co-founder of the legendary heavy metal band Metallica, celebrates his 63rd birthday on August 3.

angles.name: Metal icon
angles.copy: Happy 63rd birthday to the mighty James Hetfield of Metallica on August 3rd! What's your ultimate Metallica riff?

angles.name: Metallica tribute
angles.copy: From 'Master of Puppets' to 'Enter Sandman', James Hetfield turns 63 on Monday! Celebrate the Metallica legend with your favourite track.
